question: At least one day with >= 3 new Nearctic landbirds

model.protocol: corridor_v104 4-day window, StandardScaler + LogisticRegression(C=0.1, penalty=l2, solver=lbfgs)

skill.caveat: Modest but significant skill over climatology. Not a calibrated certainty.

error.meaning: the cycle did not carry enough forecast hours to cover every day of the window, so no probability was computed
